Description

CTHULOOT is a cooperative local multiplayer party game where players loot mysterious locations on behalf of Cthulhu. Game is playable for 1-4 players.

History

The Great Elder needs you

Famous thieves have been requested by the Great Elder to steal all the precious relics from its (cheap) rivals.

Cooperate... or not

Players have a limited movement set and they will need to cooperate to exchange items or solve puzzles. A little competition between players is in place to know who's the best looter of the group and who's the most useless one.

Features

  • Play as goofy thieves requested by the Great Elder to steal all the precious relics from its (cheap) rivals.
  • Team-up with your friends: up to 4 players in local multiplayer.
  • Unlock special watches to customize your gameplay.
  • Follow the campaign: 3 chapters, 14 levels full of surprises, and play it entirely with your crew.
  • A new family-friendly take on the Lovecraft universe.
  • GENRE: Local multiplayer, Coop, Arcade.
